lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu tudh no sadaa saalaahee piaare jichar ghat a(n)tar hai saasaa ||
lines.translation: Dear Beloved Lord, I praise You continually, as long as there is the breath within my body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾਣਉ ਬਰਸ ਪਚਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik pal khin visarahi too suaamee jaanau baras pachaasaa ||
lines.translation: If I were to forget You, for a moment, even for an instant, O Lord Master, it would be like fifty years for me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਦਾ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ham mooR mugadh sadaa se bhaaee gur kai sabad pragaasaa ||1||
lines.translation: I was always such a fool and an idiot, O Siblings of Destiny, but now, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my mind is enlightened. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu tum aape dehu bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: Dear Lord, You Yourself bestow understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu tudh vitahu vaariaa sad hee tere naam vitahu bal jaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Dear Lord, I am forever a sacrifice to You; I am dedicated and devoted to Your Name. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham sabad mue sabad maar jeevaale bhaaee sabade hee mukat paaee ||
lines.translation: I have died in the Word of the Shabad, and through the Shabad, I am dead while yet alive, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Shabad, I have been liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade man tan niramal hoaa har vasiaa man aaee ||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, my mind and body have been purified, and the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabad gur daataa jit man raataa har siu rahiaa samaaee ||2||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Giver of the Shabad; my mind is imbued with it, and I remain absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇ ਅੰਨੇ ਬੋਲੇ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad na jaanahi se a(n)ne bole se kit aae sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: Those who do not know the Shabad are blind and deaf; why did they even bother to come into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras na paaiaa birathaa janam gavaaiaa ja(n)mahi vaaro vaaraa ||
lines.translation: They do not obtain the subtle essence of the Lord's elixir; they waste away their lives, and are reincarnated over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bisataa ke keeRe bisataa maahi samaane manamukh mugadh gubaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: The blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs are like maggots in manure, and in manure they rot away. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kar vekhai maarag laae bhaaee tis bin avar na koee ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself creates us, watches over us, and places us on the Path, O Siblings of Destiny; there is no one other than Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s koi na metai bhaaee karataa kare s hoee ||
lines.translation: No one can erase that which is pre-ordained, O Siblings of Destiny; whatever the Creator wills, comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasiaa man a(n)tar bhaaee avar na doojaa koee ||4||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; O Siblings of Destiny, there is no other at all. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bhagat karahi prabh bhaavahi anadin naam vakhaane ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs practice devotional worship, and become pleasing to God; night and day, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kee saar karahi aap raakhahi jo terai man bhaane ||
lines.translation: You Yourself protect and take care of Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too gunadaataa sabad pachhaataa gun kahi gunee samaane ||1||
lines.translation: You are the Giver of virtue, realized through the Word of Your Shabad. Uttering Your Glories, we merge with You, O Glorious Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere har jeeu sadaa samaal ||
lines.translation: O my mind, remember always the Dear Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kaal teraa belee hovai sadaa nibahai terai naal || rahaau ||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, He alone shall be your best friend; He shall always stand by you. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਚਉਕੜੀ ਸਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dusat chaukaRee sadaa kooR kamaavahi naa boojhahi veechaare ||
lines.translation: The gathering of the wicked enemies shall always practice falsehood; they do not contemplate understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਤੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਣਾਖਸ ਨਖਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa dusatee te kin phal paaiaa haranaakhas nakhahi bidaare ||
lines.translation: Who can obtain fruit from the slander of evil enemies? Remember that Harnaakhash was torn apart by the Lord's claws.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: prahilaad jan sad har gun gaavai har jeeu lae ubaare ||2||
lines.translation: Prahlaad, the Lord's humble servant, constantly sang the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and the Dear Lord saved him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapas kau bahu bhalaa kar jaanahi manamukh mat na kaaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs see themselves as being very virtuous; they have absolutely no understanding at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo jan kee ni(n)daa viaape jaasan janam gavaaee ||
lines.translation: They indulge in slander of the humble spiritual people; they waste their lives away, and then they have to depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam kade chetahi naahee a(n)t gae pachhutaaee ||3||
lines.translation: They never think of the Lord's Name, and in the end, they depart, regretting and repenting. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal janam bhagataa kaa keetaa gur sevaa aap laae ||
lines.translation: The Lord makes the lives of His devotees fruitful; He Himself links them to the Guru's service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade raate sahaje maate anadin har gun gaae ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and intoxicated with celestial bliss, night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kahai bena(n)tee hau laagaa tin kai paae ||4||5||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak utters this prayer: O Lord, please, let me fall at their feet. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sikh sakhaa ba(n)dhap hai bhaaee j gur ke bhaane vich aavai ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Sikh, a friend, a relative and a sibling, who walks in the Way of the Guru's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanai bhaanai jo chalai bhaaee vichhuR chotaa khaavai ||
lines.translation: One who walks according to his own will, O Siblings of Destiny, suffers separation from the Lord, and shall be punished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur sukh kade na paavai bhaaee phir phir pachhotaavai ||1||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, peace is never obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; again and again, he regrets and repents. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke daas suhele bhaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord's slaves are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.
